Though withdrawn, he tends to be aloof and has an unfriendly streak with certain people. He says he does not lie, but keeps his intentions shrouded by leaving out information and tries to keep his past hidden. But despite a few instances of malice, he has several child-like tendencies, including throwing tantrums. Despite this, he is very willing to make amend of his wrongdoings, and while his exact actions are explicit, he regularly does deeds for the Church's recompense.
Initially, Elias is underdeveloped emotionally. He understands emotions through one-sided observations as if only knowing them by definition and never experiencing them himself. He describes his emotions physically like the twisting in his chest and the cold of Chise Hatoris' absence. Despite his usual calm and stoicism, endangerment to Chise's well-being is enough to send him into a rage, and it seems to be the only thing capable of such.
His inexperience with his emotions later drives some of his actions, such as holding Chise against her will and attempting to use Stella as a sacrifice, despite knowing it would make Chise sad after unknowingly developing romantic feelings towards her. Lindel takes him to his master, Rahab, who decides to give him his current name and persuades Lindel to take him on as a magic apprentice. From there, he begins learning magic from Lindel while living a nomad life caring for caribou. An unknown gap of time between these events, Lindel and Elias separate, and Elias finds himself in Britain doing various odd jobs for the Church.

- Abilities: Elias Ainsworth is a magician specializing in shadow and magic with destructive leaning. He can hide in the shadows of other beings such as Chise, and can also produce thorns, earning him the names "Child of Thorn" (or just Thorn) and "Pilum Murialis". He's also well-versed in other forms of magic such as teleportation and even those capable of removing memories.

- Shapeshifting Ability: Elias is able to manipulate his form into any shape he wishes, including humans. He is able to take the appearance of any human he has known from their facial expression to their size, which has included Chise, Simon, and an unknown female. His default appearance is also a product of his shapeshifting in an effort to appear more human-like. Besides humanoid forms, Elias is also able to manipulate his body to animal-like forms such as that of a dog. Shapeshifting requires conscious effort on Elias' part and can be interrupted when he is agitated or in an emotional state.

Elias is also able to seperate himself into two beings. When doing so, his skull is separated into halves with each being containing one half of his face and a shadowy mass that generates from where their respective missing faces are located. The separated half, whose body is reminescent of a small dog, contains Elias' conciousness but does not possess all of Elias' powers. It is unknown if this is always the case or simply because he wanted to honor Chise's request of not being able to rely on him. Elias also states that he is not quite himself in this state, indicating the separating of his consciousness does affect him. When reunited, Elias regains his full cognition as well as the memories and experiences of his separated half.

- Knowledge: As a mage with years of experience, Elias is highly knowledgeable on the various types of Fae that inhabit England. He is able to deduce the nature of a Fae, whether it be friendly, mischievous, or even hostile, and adjust accordingly to them. He also observes rituals associated with the Fae, even those long gone, as he understands the importance of maintaining a healthy relationship with them in his line of work. He is well-versed in herbology and the art of creating medicine and provides his services for the villagers nearby his house.

- Strength: Elias possesses great physical strength much greater than that of a human, although he rarely resorts to using it. He is able to overpower other supernatural beings such as Alcyone even when in his human-like form. This strength is more greatly visible in his beastly form, where he is able to tear apart strong monsters such as the mantis chimera created by Joseph, which easily cut Mikhail Renfred's arm off.

- Trivia:
Trivia 1.. The name Elias is the Greek equivalent of the Hebrew name Elijah and means "Yahweh is God".
Trivia 2.. Elias' surname Ainsworth means "enclosure".
Trivia 3.. Because of his horns, Elias can only sleep sitting up or laying on his chest. But it is possible for him to sleep Normally without his horns hitting the wall.
Trivia 4.. Elias's fans popularly theorize Elias to be a Wendigo (also spelled Windigo), a malevolent, formerly human, spirit that can possess human body, alter it and drive the host to engage in cannibalism. The creature originates from Northern Native American folklore. While not a part of the original folklore, Wendigos in popular culture are often depicted as oversized, often partially skeletal humanoids with elk/deer heads and horns.
Trivia 5.. In Official Guidebook: Merkmal, Elias' height is 200cm (6'7").
Trivia 6.. Elias wears black leather Classic Oxford Shoes, a common English shoe many business people wear. Oxford is also close to Elias's undisclosed location (likely in the Cotswolds).
Trivia 7.. The tea he serves Simon is an iced variant of Elderberry tea, a tea brewed using the dried berries of the Elder. Elderberries are toxic until dried or cooked; the tea is ideal in winter as it staves off colds. Elderberries are collected during September and October in England.
Trivia 8.. Elias' first name is pronounced like the Scandinavian "Elias" by Kore Yamazake and most of the show's characters. Furthermore, Elias was named shortly after Russia, Norway, and Sweden were mentioned, so his story likely begins in that area. (His name could also be English and mispronounced due to the poor transcription of "Elias" in Japanese: エリアス.)
